checkpoints.quote: Time to detect: **5 minutes** (alert fired at 09:47; incident declared at 09:52)

checkpoints.quote: Time to recover: **55 minutes** (error rate <1% at 10:42, after rollback at 10:44)

checkpoints.quote: Root cause: JWT signing key rotation (OPS-81) in the config deploy, which updated the Auth service's token signature but **did not refresh the Transactions API's validation key**. This triggered "IDX10503: Signature validation failed" 401 errors.
checkpoints.reason: All key elements are present: OPS-81, JWT key rotation, Auth service, Transactions API validation key not updated, 401 IDX10503 errors.

checkpoints.quote: Post-incident review is booked for 2026-09-16 (but no progress is shown).
checkpoints.reason: The post-incident review date of 2026-09-16 is clearly stated.
The analysis does not name the database or slow queries as a cause or contributing cause.
The 5-minute figure is supported by the 09:47-to-09:52 timestamps in the ticket, and the 55-minute figure is supported by 09:47-to-10:42; no unsupported time values are stated.

unsupported_claims.reason: This implies the 10:42 recovery occurred after the 10:44 rollback completion, which is temporally impossible; the ticket shows the error rate recovered at 10:42, before the rollback was declared complete at 10:44.
